plainText:
Chikorita's Saint Valentine (Japanese: チコのｓｔバレンタインの巻, 's St. Valentine), is the third chapter of the eighth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Chiko wants to make Valentine's Day chocolate for Almond, but she's no good at it. And is it really Almond her heart is set on?

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Chiko
Hazel
Coconut

Peanut
